notes: Measurement-only alpha-enabling governance. No strategy, signal, ranking, sizing, exit, order, Gate, novelty, saturation, reopen, run.py, or baseline change. The generator emits 0-2 exploration/adjacent research leads and may abstain; it is not an EvidenceSurface or candidate kind. Candidate projection is null unless observable prior, authorized canonical-PIT sources, post-generation no-conflict history disposition, and explicitly existing surface IDs all hold; every projection remains lead and ineligible for panel. Digest freshness uses a hash-bound sidecar with research_date America/Los_Angeles, scan run/version/skill hash, and published entry IDs; digest generated_at alone is not freshness. Formal D3 and experiment novelty guards still recompute canonical veto before promotion/reservation. Active desktop research automation already references docs/research_digest_pipeline.md, so the contract is consumable on its next run; splitting it from the broad Chore task and narrowing the hourly Alpha schedule remain external scheduler follow-ups.
